ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring pipeline that cross-references multi-spectral spatial imagery with state environmental databases to automatically detect industrial zoning violations and illegal waste dumping.
ideas.title: EcoCompliant-SAT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Data Science department's focus on industry, government, and NGO problem statements, this leverages high-impact geospatial data analysis proven by previous satellite monitoring winners.

ideas.pitch: An automated data lineage and incident response platform tailored for agricultural supply chain logistics, detecting sensor anomalies and automatically generating root-cause audit trails.
ideas.title: AgriTrace-Lineage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering in data pipeline telemetry with real-world utility for agricultural NGOs and government oversight bodies.

ideas.pitch: A clinical decision support dashboard predicting patient readmission rates using tabular data models, paired with SHAP values to provide doctors with real-time explainable risk factors.
ideas.title: MediExplain-XGB
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical healthcare infrastructure challenges demanded by domain experts while guaranteeing strict clinical interpretability via transparent ML tooling.

ideas.pitch: A standalone fairness and bias auditing platform designed to scan student placement and resume-screening algorithms for demographic bias, generating immediate mitigation reports.
ideas.title: FairLens-Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents a crucial governance and ethical AI tool that directly appeals to academic committees and societal impact evaluation metrics.

ideas.pitch: A localized video intelligence platform that ingests unstructured public assembly or parliamentary proceedings, transcribing and indexing key policy discussions into a fully searchable knowledge graph.
ideas.title: GovVideo-Index
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real-world document and media accessibility pain points for government organizations and public administrative bodies.
